title: Saves into a held, undrawn erase: lab imports and document saves do not pass applyInTurn's refusal
evidence: From the Codex re-check of PR 1599. ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore+Uploads.swift importLabsInTurn (:31, engine.cloudLabImport) and saveDocumentInTurn (:80, engine.documentSave) call the cloud session directly, so they skip the refusal applyInTurn gives a record held with no drawing. Not reachable from the screen today: the upload button sits in My health's list (MyDataView.swift:309), which shows 'Your record did not load' while the record is held, and a review opened before the erase pinned the older screen (LabUploadSheet.swift:245, LabReviewView.swift:90), whose mark no longer holds, so shows(seen) refuses it. If one did run, the person would see 'saved'; the session keeps the values, and the screen draws the new record, which ends the held state, or stays on 'Your record did not load' if that draw fails too. A fix gives both paths the same refusal, with a test. US-25 AC16f
